title: 手回し輪付きブロック氷削り機
description: 祭りや軽食店の台上に置く手回し式かき氷機。鋳物風アーチ、開放円筒室と固定押し板、実形状のねじ山、側面の輪形ハンドル/握り、下部の刃支持部と空の受け空間を造形しています。氷や器は含まず、机の高さに合わせて配置します。刃・輪・ねじは固定で、切削・伝動・食品機器の安全性能は実装・検証していない静的な外観モデルです。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.456 × 0.698 × 0.313 m、14,340三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A hand-cranked shaved-ice machine for festival and snack-counter scenes. A cast-style arch carries an open cylindrical block chamber, fixed pressure plate, geometric screw thread, side crank wheel/grip, lower blade carrier and empty receiving space. Ice and serving bowls are omitted; place at counter height. Blade, wheel and screw are fixed, with no cutting, transmission or validated food-equipment safety performance. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.456 × 0.698 × 0.313 m; 14,340 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
